description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing historical market capitalization data from Intrinio's API, including query parameter classes, data models, and asynchronous data fetching and transformation methods.

classes.name: IntrinioHistoricalMarketCapQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Intrinio historical market cap data, including symbol and interval options.

classes.name: IntrinioHistoricalMarketCapData
classes.description: Data model representing Intrinio's historical market cap data, with alias for 'market_cap' as 'value'.

classes.name: IntrinioHistoricalMarketCapFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that transforms queries, retrieves data asynchronously from Intrinio API, and processes the data into models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a query object, setting default start and end dates if missing.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches historical market cap data for symbols from Intrinio API, handling errors and response validation.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into sorted list of IntrinioHistoricalMarketCapData models.
